candidates.original_title: Systematic identification of genomic markers of drug sensitivity in cancer cells
candidates.description: Ewing’s sarcoma cell lines are more sensitive to the PARP inhibitor olaparib than osteosarcoma control cell lines.
candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment is comparable to what was reported in Figure 4C and Supplemental Figure 16 of Garnett et al. (2012) and described in Protocol 1 in the Registered Report (Vanden Heuvel et al., 2016).
candidates.notes: The replication effect was in the same direction as the original but was not statistically significant; the authors explicitly summarize it this way. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Systematic identification of genomic markers of drug sensitivity in cancer cells
candidates.description: The EWS-FLI1 rearrangement is sufficient to increase olaparib sensitivity in transformed mouse mesenchymal cells, producing sensitivity similar to that of Ewing’s sarcoma cells and greater sensitivity than FUS-CHOP-transformed cells.
candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment is similar to what was reported in Figure 4E of Garnett et al. (2012) and described in Protocol 2 in the Registered Report (Vanden Heuvel et al., 2016).
candidates.notes: The EWS-FLI1-transformed cells were relatively resistant rather than olaparib-sensitive, and the authors state that the results were not in the same direction as the original study. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Systematic identification of genomic markers of drug sensitivity in cancer cells
candidates.description: Depletion of EWS-FLI1 from A673 Ewing’s sarcoma cells partially rescues their sensitivity to olaparib.
candidates.citation_sentence: To test if EWS-FLI1 is necessary for olaparib sensitivity, we replicated an experiment similar to what was reported in Figure 4F and Supplemental Figure 20 in Garnett et al. (2012) and described in Protocol 3 in the Registered Report (Vanden Heuvel et al., 2016).
candidates.notes: EWS-FLI1 depletion and control cells displayed similar olaparib sensitivities; the authors state that the cell viability results were not in the same direction as the original study. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]
